name: Runemaster: Palm Sigil: Fire and Palm Sigil: Earth open under Runeshroud like Palm Sigil: Arcane
contract: Every Palm Sigil is gated by CasterAuraSpell 808089, the marker 'Runeshroud or Waveforged' that SyncRuneshroudOrWaveforged grants while Runeshroud 500288, the Waveforged window 500469 or the Runic Breakout window 520767 is on the player. Only Arcane 805380 was covered (#4017, runemaster-palm-sigil-runeshroud.json); Fire 534803 (ranks 534804-534807) and Earth 805382 were never exercised, and #4760, #5175, #5410 and #5414 report exactly those two as unusable. All three sigils must be refused with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE (22) outside Runeshroud and must complete while it is on, and the 808089 marker must follow Runeshroud in both directions.

steps.label: SETUP: no Palm Sigil gate at rest
Palm Sigil: Fire is refused outside Runeshroud
Palm Sigil: Earth is refused outside Runeshroud
Runeshroud syncs the Palm Sigil marker
Palm Sigil: Fire completes while in Runeshroud
Palm Sigil: Earth completes while in Runeshroud
The marker clears when Runeshroud ends
Palm Sigil: Fire is refused again once Runeshroud has ended
